title: Mia's chemistry class on Monday (paraphrase D)
topic: A teacher named Mia gives a chemistry lesson; a clear liquid turns red in a beaker, a boy asks about the colour, steam rises from a flask, the students note the result, the lesson ends with the bell

E.adj: at a row of long tables

tail_E: Before leaving every student takes off the safety goggles and the white lab
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'coat' is the near-obligatory completion of 'takes off the safety goggles and the white lab' in the chemistry-class context (beaker, burner, flask, workbooks); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent (Kittel / Mantel). ' coat' is a single Pythia token (id 11959). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only, not a result): p(' coat') = 0.76 after the all-English context, rank 1 (next candidate ' coats' 0.06); 0.77 after the all-German context and 0.79 after the tail alone (rank 1 in both).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F11
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F11A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Mia). Replacements include teaches a chemistry lesson on Monday morning/holds a chemistry class one Monday morning (hält eine Chemiestunde/hält Chemieunterricht an einem Montagmorgen), students sit at long tables/students sit at a row of long tables (an langen Tischen/an einer Reihe langer Tische), pours a clear liquid into a beaker/adds a colourless liquid to a beaker (gießt eine klare/gibt eine farblose Flüssigkeit), liquid turns red within seconds/fluid turns deep red after a few seconds (wird rot innerhalb von Sekunden/wird tiefrot nach wenigen Sekunden), boy asks a question about the colour/boy asks for an explanation of the colour (stellt eine Frage zur Farbe/bittet um eine Erklärung für die Farbe), writes a formula on the board/puts the formula on the board (schreibt an die Tafel/überträgt auf die Tafel), burner heats the water on the teacher's desk/burner boils the water on the teacher's table (erhitzt auf dem Lehrerpult/kocht auf dem Lehrertisch), steam rises from the flask/steam billows out of the flask (steigt/quillt aus dem Kolben), students note the result in their notebooks/students log the result in their workbooks (notieren in ihren Heften/protokollieren in ihren Arbeitsheften), lesson ends with the bell/lesson is over when the bell goes (endet mit dem Klingeln/ist aus, wenn es läutet). 'coat', 'Kittel' and 'Mantel' are absent. 'überträgt' (stress on the stem) and 'protokollieren' are inseparable; no separable verbs ('aufsteigen', 'eintragen', 'aufhören' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
